name: OpenClaw Deploy
description: Run the fixed OpenClaw deploy flow with a bounded environment plus approved service and release manifests.

service_manifest.description: Relative service manifest that defines the approved deploy target

release_file.description: Relative release or artifact manifest file bound by content hash

steps.description: Run the bounded OpenClaw deploy task via the dedicated task wrapper

constraints: The flow id is fixed to deploy
Execution is fixed to write scope with no escalation
Only preview or staging are allowed deploy environments
The deploy target and artifact are bound to approved content-hash inputs
Outputs must pass OpenClaw verification before the recipe completes
invariants: No alternate OpenClaw flow can be substituted at runtime
No scope other than write is allowed for this recipe
Deploy verification must refer to the same environment, service manifest, and release file tuple
